summary: Canadian Natural Resources Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting an amendment to the record date for its quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share. The record date was changed from June 19, 2026, to June 23, 2026; the dividend remains payable on July 7, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and record date correction, not a special situation. No change in dividend rate, capital return program, or strategic event is indicated. The filing represents an ordinary course disclosure update for a foreign private issuer.
